module
public import Init

namespace Fixture

/- The words sorry and axiom in comments are not proof holes. /-
Nested comments can mention admit too.
-/ -/
def description : String := "sorry, admit, axiom"
noncomputable def chosen {α : Type} (h : Nonempty α) : α := Classical.choice h
theorem ext (p q : Prop) (h : p ↔ q) : p = q := propext h
theorem quotient (a b : Nat) :
    Quot.mk (fun _ _ : Nat => True) a = Quot.mk (fun _ _ : Nat => True) b :=
  Quot.sound True.intro

end Fixture
